name: Dante
source:
Dante is a hard worker: he has to keep a fire lit beneath him or he'll burn out, and he radiates a warm and fun personality as a result. He's easy to warm up to, and he's prepared to cheer you up on a moment's notice. He wants to teach you the Way of the Flame - are you ready for his lessons?
Likes: Slow Burns Dislikes: Shortcuts

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
